correctness.rationale: For F_m(r)=p(1-r^m)/(1+r^m)-2r^N/(1-r), the derivative is strictly negative on (0,1). The finite-m root is strictly increasing in m and lies below the unique limiting root A solving p=2A^N/(1-A). The mean value theorem expresses the gap exactly as the source defect at A divided by -F_m' at an intermediate point. The m-dependent derivative term vanishes because m A^(m-1)->0, yielding the stated exact prefactor.

The result determines how quickly increasing vanishing order improves the sharp radius and connects the fresh improved radius to the powered Bohr radius p/(p+2) with an exact exponential deficit.
